_about: Generated by tools/whatsnew_v142.py - do not edit. Screenshots taken in the mGBA 0.10.5 engine: the crash on the v1.4.1 ROM (r09), the rest on the v1.4.2 ROM itself (r10). The title screen of v1.4.2 still shows v1.4 by owner decision, so the v1.4 title picture is correct.
heading: DexNav no longer crashes on WEEZING
lead: v1.4.2 is a small bug-fix update. Hunting WEEZING on Cinnabar Island with DexNav now works like any other search.
desc: DexNav no longer crashes when hunting WEEZING on Cinnabar Island

shots.title: The crash, in v1.4.1
shots.caption: A DexNav search for WEEZING on Cinnabar Island stopped the game on this blue screen. Its encounter level range was stored in reverse.

shots.title: Search for WEEZING
shots.caption: In v1.4.2, open DexNav on Cinnabar Island, choose WEEZING and press A. Registering it and pressing R in the field works too.

shots.title: WEEZING found
shots.caption: The search finds WEEZING in the grass at Lv. 42–43, the same levels as before.

shots.title: Battle and catch
shots.caption: Walk to it and the battle starts normally. WEEZING can be caught as usual.
